fullContent:
Rajata Chandrodaya 
 Reference – Bheshaja Samhita 
 Introduction 
 Rajata Chandrodaya is an ayurvedic formulation which is prepared from the mixture of effective minerals. The formulation word Rajata Chandrodaya is raised from the combination of two words – rajata and chandrodaya. Rajata reflects the meaning silver and chandrodaya reflects the brilliant shine and beauty of the body. This medicine enhances the body strength and clear the impurities. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Suddha Rajata 
 Suddha Parada 
 Suddha Gandhaka 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 This formulation is prepared through the method of Kupipakva method. 
 In kupipakva method, the ingredients filled in the kupi (glass flask) and the kupi is covered with a cloth that is coated with seven layers of clay. Dry this kupi. 
 Now take the kupi and bury this in balukayantra up to its neck and start the process of heating. 
 Heat is provided in three stages – mild, mid and high flame. 
 Now seal the flask bottle using chalk pieces which are wrapped around cloth strips. The cloth should be smeared in the paste of jaggery. 
 Now take the flask and cool it down. 
 Break the flask into two pieces and collect the product from its neck. 
 
 Dose 
 125 mg, two times a day. 
 Indications 
 
 Blood impurity 
 Blood tonic 
 Excessive heat in the body. 
 Spermatorrhea 
 Sexual potency 
 Anxiety 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
